parse.title: Death Ninja
parse.text:
Limited Unit
This unit is only available for a short time!

Overview

Death Ninja is a MythicalMythical Limited unit. He is only obtainable through opening Spooky Stars.

Evolving

Death Ninja can evolve into Death Ninja (Immortal Butcher) with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Death Ninja
x1 Triple-Bladed Scythe Triple-Bladed Scythe
x12 Star Fruit
x3 Star Fruit (Blue)
x5 Star Fruit (Red)
x4 Star Fruit (Pink)
x1 Star Fruit (Rainbow)
Result
Death Ninja (Immortal Butcher)

Before evolving this unit, the unit must have 5000 Takedowns. [1]

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
